title: acilepis chiangdaoensis
intro: Acilepis chiangdaoensis, commonly known as Thai mountain mint, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used in Thai medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acilepis chiangdaoensis include wound healing, fever reduction, and digestive system regulation. The bioactive constituents of Acilepis chiangdaoensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
